package.name: xela_taxel_operator_dg5f
package.description: DG-5F operator-only web app. Serves a standalone operator page (3D taxel view + session/ alert/status widgets) via its own dedicated rosbridge_server instance and its own static web server, entirely independent of xela_taxel_sidecar_dg5f (Admin+Operator combined sidecar, left unmodified). Reuses xela_taxel_viz_core's rendering pipeline (rosbridge client, 3D scene/URDF mesh renderer, TF resolution + taxel marker renderer) and xela_atag_taxel_viewer's operator/session JS widgets -- no ROS node of its own beyond the dedicated rosbridge_server instance.
